description: The geo module with SID_MODULE_CONFIG={"geo":{"precision":"coarse"}}: only the coarse fields (type, country, region, metro, utcoffset), whatever the consent. Requests describe the visitor's location with Cloudflare's visitor location headers (cf-ipcountry, cf-region-code, cf-ipcity, cf-postal-code, cf-metro-code, cf-iplatitude, cf-iplongitude, cf-timezone, cf-ipcontinent): the Node.js target reads them because it runs with SID_TRUST_PROXY, and the runner gives the Workers runtime the same values as request.cf. The time zones have no daylight saving time, so utcoffset is fixed. TC string CAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA opts in to Special Feature 1 and nothing else.

cases.name: sends only the coarse fields even with opt-in to precise geolocation
